title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 376 (Power to wind up foreign companies, although dissolved)

content.overview: Where a company incorporated outside India which has been carrying on business in India ceases to carry on business in India, it may be wound up as an unregistered company under this Part, notwithstanding that it has been dissolved or otherwise ceased to exist under the laws of the country under which it was incorporated.
content.glance: A foreign company that ceases business in India may be wound up as an unregistered company under this Part even if dissolved in its home country.
